label: Tones and vowel length
desc: Sets of words that differ only in tone or vowel length: มา / ม้า / หมา, ใกล้ / ไกล, ข้าว / ขาว / เขา.

label: Consonants: mid and high class
desc: The mid-class and high-class letters, each with its traditional name word (ก ไก่, ข ไข่).

label: Consonants: low class
desc: The common low-class letters with their name words, and the sounds they share with high-class letters.

label: Vowels and tone marks
desc: One short word for each vowel shape and each tone mark.

label: Greetings and politeness
desc: Hello, thank you, sorry and the polite particles, for male and female speakers.

label: People and family
desc: Pronouns, kinship terms as "you" and "I", and family words.

label: About me
desc: Name, country, job, languages: introducing yourself with ชื่อ, เป็น and มาจาก.

label: Numbers and money
desc: Numbers to a million and prices in baht.

label: Counting with classifiers
desc: Noun + number + classifier for people, animals, books, cups, bottles and more.

label: Food and drink
desc: Dishes, tastes and the phrases for ordering and paying.

label: Describing things
desc: Describing words after the noun, colors, this and that, and comparisons.

label: Time and days
desc: Days, parts of the day, the Thai clock and time words.

label: Directions and places
desc: Places in town and the words for left, right, near and far.

label: Getting around
desc: Taxis, tuk-tuks, the BTS and tickets.

label: Shopping and colors
desc: Prices, bargaining politely, clothes and colors.

label: Health and feelings
desc: How you feel, what hurts, and the pharmacy.

label: Questions and requests
desc: Question words, yes/no questions and polite requests with ขอ and ช่วย.

label: Traps for English speakers
desc: False friends and word-for-word copies: เป็น with describing words, ฝรั่ง, ฟิต, อิ่ม, เผ็ด.

label: Compliments
desc: Everyday praise for food, work, skills and homes, and the modest Thai way to answer it. Cards are plain: men add ครับ, women add ค่ะ.

label: Flirting
desc: Words for flirting, phrases built from them, and how to ask someone out, say yes, or say no kindly, for male and female speakers.

label: Top nouns
desc: The most-used Thai nouns. Nouns never change: no plural, no article; the note gives the classifier.

label: Top verbs
desc: The most-used verbs. Thai verbs never change for person or time; time words do that work.

label: Top adjectives
desc: Describing words: they go after the noun and work like verbs, with no เป็น.

label: Top adverbs
desc: Very, already, still, often, here, now: mostly after the verb or at the end.

label: Top pronouns
desc: Beyond the basics in People and family: น้อง, หนู, ป้า as I and you, plus mine and yours, who, what and everyone.

label: Top prepositions
desc: ที่, ใน, บน, กับ, จาก, ถึง and the ข้าง… place words.

label: Top conjunctions
desc: And, but, or, because, if, so, when: joining ideas in Thai.

label: Top words
desc: Question words, this and that after the noun, numbers to twenty, yes and no, days and time words.

label: Top classifiers
desc: More classifiers for counting: noun + number + classifier.

label: Top particles
desc: The little words at the end of a sentence: คะ, นะ, สิ, เลย, ล่ะ, หรอก and more.
